TZ.description: Timezone (used for Jellyfin metadata + scheduled library scans)

JELLYFIN_PORT.description: Port for the Jellyfin web UI + API

JELLYFIN_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Jellyfin admin password — auto-generated. ServiceBay walks the first-run wizard via the /Startup/* API after deploy so first login works. Family members can either share this account, get their own via Settings → Users, or you enable jellyfin-plugin-sso later for Authelia SSO.

JELLYFIN_MEDIA_PATH.description: Host path mounted at /media (read-only). Defaults to the file-share volume so Music/, Movies/, TV/ etc. dropped into the Samba share appear in Jellyfin's library scan.

JELLYFIN_GPU_PASSTHROUGH.description: NVIDIA hardware transcoding (NVENC/NVDEC). Non-blank (the default, 'yes') hands Jellyfin the host's CDI-registered NVIDIA GPU and switches Jellyfin's own transcoding setting to NVENC — without both, one film re-encode eats several CPU cores while the card idles (#2580). Safe to leave on: a host with no CDI GPU (`/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml` absent) is detected at deploy time and keeps the plain pod + software transcoding. Set to blank to force software transcoding even on a GPU box. No VRAM budget and no cap on concurrent transcodes — a deliberate operator decision, see #2580.

LLDAP_LDAP_PORT.description: LLDAP LDAP-protocol port — Jellyfin's LDAP-Auth plugin binds LLDAP here for SSO (#1718). Inherited from the auth template.

LLDAP_BASE_DN.description: LLDAP base DN (e.g. dc=example,dc=com) — Jellyfin's LDAP-Auth plugin search base. Leave blank: ServiceBay derives it from PUBLIC_DOMAIN at install time, matching what the auth template initialised LLDAP with.

LLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: LLDAP admin password — Jellyfin's LDAP-Auth plugin uses it as the bind DN for user lookup (#1718). Inherited from the auth template when both are installed together.

MEDIA_SUBDOMAIN.description: Subdomain for Jellyfin — the general media server (music + audiobooks + video), so `media` fits better than the old per-content `music`/`books`. Web UI + Symfonium/Findroid/Streamyfin endpoint. Quick Connect handles mobile-app pairing — the app shows a 6-digit code, you confirm it once in the web UI and the app is paired without a shared password.

proxyConfig.advanced_config:
# Jellyfin needs a higher body limit for chunked uploads (cover
# art replacement, library imports). Default NPM cap of 1MB rejects
# those.
client_max_body_size 100M;
